CA1069.shortDescription: Enums values should not be duplicated

S2346.shortDescription: Flags enumerations zero-value members should be named "None"
S2346.fullDescription: Consistent use of "None" in flags enumerations indicates that all flag values are cleared. The value 0 should not be used to indicate any other state, since there is no way to check that the bit 0 is set.

S3776.shortDescription: Cognitive Complexity of methods should not be too high
S3776.fullDescription: Cognitive Complexity is a measure of how hard the control flow of a method is to understand. Methods with high Cognitive Complexity will be difficult to maintain.

S4790.shortDescription: Using weak hashing algorithms is security-sensitive
S4790.fullDescription: Cryptographic hash algorithms such as MD2, MD4, MD5, MD6, HAVAL-128, HMAC-MD5, DSA (which uses SHA-1), RIPEMD, RIPEMD-128, RIPEMD-160, HMACRIPEMD160 and SHA-1 are no longer considered secure, because it is possible to have collisions (little computational effort is enough to find two or more different inputs that produce the same hash).
